problems.question: Which community helper uses a hose and puts out fires?
problems.rationale: Firefighters wear protective hats and use strong hoses with water to put out fires. A police badge belongs to police officers who keep neighborhoods safe, while a stethoscope is used by doctors. The firefighter hat matches the brave helper who puts out fires.
problems.teachingNote: Reinforce community helpers by discussing the unique tools and uniforms each worker uses to help people stay safe.
successCriteria: Identify the tools and gear associated with firefighters
